cx.doc: Circle center x, as a fraction of canvas width

cy.doc: Circle center y, as a fraction of canvas height

softness.doc: Feather width of the circle edge, as a fraction of the canvas short side; 0 = hard edge

invert.doc: true = circle **shrinks**: starts from the farthest canvas corner with the incoming frame and ends at the center

doc: A circle opens from its center, and the incoming frame replaces the inside of the circle. Let d be the Euclidean distance from each pixel to the center (cx·W, cy·H), and R the distance from the center to the farthest canvas corner; u = d (invert = false) or u = R − d (invert = true, circle shrinks). It uses exactly the same sweep formula as transition.wipe: e = progress × (R + S + 1), cov = clamp((e − u) / S, 0, 1) (S = 0 gives cov = [u < e]), where S is the feather width in pixels. cov = 0 / 1 take the original bytes directly, and intermediate values are composited with the integer blend from transition.crossfade, so progress = 0 / 1 is byte-identical to from / to.
